title: Capiba — Custos (uso × requests)
description: Uso real de CPU/memória por pod vs os requests declarados no values.yaml, e ociosidade. Fontes: marts gold pod_usage_hourly e platform_cost_daily (dbt).

options.content: Uso real coletado pelo pipeline `hourly_pod_usage` (metrics-server) → bronze `raw_pod_usage` → mart `pod_usage_hourly`. Os requests vêm da seed dbt `requests.csv`, gerada a partir do values.yaml — **regerar a seed sempre que os requests do chart mudarem**. Ociosidade = 1 − (uso médio ÷ request); valores altos indicam requests superdimensionados.

panels.title: Uso real × request — memória (MiB, por dia/pod)

targets.rawSql: SELECT dt, pod, round(avg_memory_bytes / 1048576.0, 1) AS avg_mib, round(max_memory_bytes / 1048576.0, 1) AS max_mib, round(request_memory_bytes / 1048576.0, 1) AS request_mib, round(memory_idle_ratio * 100, 1) AS idle_pct FROM gold.capiba.platform_cost_daily ORDER BY dt DESC, pod

panels.title: Uso real × request — CPU (millicores, por dia/pod)

targets.rawSql: SELECT dt, pod, round(avg_cpu_millicores, 1) AS avg_mc, request_cpu_millicores AS request_mc, round(cpu_idle_ratio * 100, 1) AS idle_pct FROM gold.capiba.platform_cost_daily ORDER BY dt DESC, pod

SELECT hour, pod, round(avg_cpu_millicores, 1) AS avg_mc, max_cpu_millicores AS max_mc, round(avg_memory_bytes / 1048576.0, 1) AS avg_mib, round(max_memory_bytes / 1048576.0, 1) AS max_mib, samples FROM gold.capiba.pod_usage_hourly ORDER BY hour DESC, pod
